title: Localized conormal complement of a finite polynomial presentation
statement: Let R and A be commutative rings with an R-algebra structure, and let P be a finite polynomial presentation of A with n variables and m relations [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. For a in A such that S=A_a is smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], there is an S-linear equivalence (S tensor_A P.Cotangent) times Omega[S/R] equiv (Fin n -> S), where P.Cotangent is the conormal module I/I^2 of P and Omega is [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. No equality of the universes of R and A is required.

proof.text: Put S=A_a. Lift a to G.sigma(a) in the polynomial algebra of the generators G underlying P. Apply the principal-localization naive-cotangent theorem to obtain the injectivity equivalence between the localized original differential d and the differential of the enlarged presentation Q, and an equivalence of their cokernels.

The polynomial ring of Q is formally smooth over R. Mathlib Algebra.Extension.cotangentComplex_injective_iff and smoothness of S give injectivity of the differential of Q; transfer it to d. The conormal cokernel theorem identifies the cokernel of Q with Omega[S/R], hence W/range(d) is projective.

Split W -> W/range(d) using LinearMap.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective and Function.Exact.splitSurjectiveEquiv. Identify W with S^n using the base-changed polynomial differential basis. Compose the product and inverse equivalences to obtain (S tensor_A P.Cotangent) times Omega[S/R] equiv S^n.
